description: Source code for map control channel selection, including functions for managing control channels, operating classes, and multi-AP band configurations in a wireless network controller.

classes.name: chan_sel_multiap_band_t
classes.description: Structure representing control and bad channel sets for a specific band in multi-AP configuration.

classes.name: chan_sel_multiap_t
classes.description: Structure holding multi-AP band configurations for 2G, 5G, 6G, and unknown bands.

methods.name: int_to_str
methods.description: Converts an integer value to string, or '-' if null.

methods.name: band_to_str
methods.description: Returns string representation of radio frequency band and sub-band info.

methods.name: bool_to_str
methods.description: Converts a boolean pointer to 'true', 'false', or '-' string.

methods.name: print_op_class_list
methods.description: Prints a list of operation classes with preferences and reasons.

methods.name: is_backhaul_radio
methods.description: Checks if a radio has backhaul profile.

methods.name: get_multiap_band
methods.description: Returns pointer to multi-AP band structure based on band ID.

methods.name: print_multiap_band
methods.description: Prints control and bad channel sets for a specific band.

methods.name: is_bad_preference
methods.description: Determines if an operating class indicates a bad control channel preference.

methods.name: set_bad_channels
methods.description: Sets list of bad control channels based on preferences.

methods.name: set_def_pref_channels
methods.description: Sets default preferred control channels based on global config and supported channels.

methods.name: set_pref_channels
methods.description: Sets preferred control channels, removing unsupported or bad channels.

methods.name: is_channel_available
methods.description: Checks if a channel is available according to CAC status report.

methods.name: set_eu_weatherband_preference
methods.description: Adjusts preference for EU weatherband channels to avoid CAC triggers.

methods.name: set_controller_pref_op_class_list
methods.description: Configures controller's preferred operating class list based on supported classes and channels.

methods.name: set_merged_pref_op_class_list
methods.description: Merges agent and controller preferred operating class lists.

methods.name: update_pref_channel_op_class_list
methods.description: Updates all preferred control channels and operating class lists.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_set
methods.description: Sets control channel selection parameters for a radio.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_set_channel
methods.description: Sets a fixed control channel for a radio.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_set_bandwidth
methods.description: Sets bandwidth for control channel selection.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_update
methods.description: Updates control channel selection based on current configuration.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_dump
methods.description: Dumps current control channel selection and radio info.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_init
methods.description: Initializes multi-AP control channel selection configuration.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_fini
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up control channel selection resources.
